## Part 1


```{r}
input <- read_lines(I(
  "H => HO
H => OH
O => HH"
))

inp <- read_lines("input/19")
input <- inp[seq_len(which(inp == "") - 1L)]
medicine_molecule <- inp[length(inp)]

fission_rep <- list()

for (i in input) {
  fission_rep[[str_extract(i, "^\\w+")]] <- append(
    fission_rep[[str_extract(i, "^\\w+")]],
    str_extract(i, "\\w+$")
  )
}

#medicine_molecule <- "HOH"
```



```{r}
reps <- fastmap()
counter <- 0L


for (p in names(fission_rep)) {
  loc <- str_locate_all(medicine_molecule, p)[[1]]
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(loc))) {
    for (r in fission_rep[[p]]) {
      new <- medicine_molecule
      str_sub(new, loc[i, "start"], loc[i, "end"]) <- r
      counter <- counter + 1L
      #message(paste(p, i, r, new, medicine_molecule))
      reps$set(new, 1L)
    }
  }
}

#reps$keys()
reps$size()
```
